notes: Known-vulnerable TPM firmware, used by SU-08. manufacturers are TCG vendor ids as Windows reports them (Win32_Tpm ManufacturerIdTxt). affected ranges are inclusive and compared on the precision given, so 4.33 matches 4.33.4. Candidate for hosting centrally with this file as the fallback.

advisories.title: Infineon TPM RSA key generation weakness (ROCA)
advisories.advice: RSA keys generated by this TPM can be recovered from their public key. Install the TPM firmware update from the device manufacturer, clear the TPM as they instruct, then re-create TPM-backed keys (BitLocker protectors, Windows Hello, certificates).

advisories.title: Intel PTT ECDSA timing leak (TPM-FAIL)
advisories.advice: Install the Intel Management Engine (CSME) firmware update from the device manufacturer (INTEL-SA-00241), then re-create ECDSA keys held in the TPM.

advisories.title: STMicroelectronics ST33 TPM ECDSA timing leak (TPM-FAIL)
advisories.advice: Install the TPM firmware update from the device manufacturer, then re-create ECDSA keys held in the TPM.
